prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: LG Laundry Remote Monitor - RLM20K; description: LG Laundry Remote Monitor - RLM20K/ Makes It Easier To Keep Tabs On Your Laundry/ Communicates With The Machine To Display The Time Remaining In The Cycle

Candidates:
1. name: LG Semi-Integrated Electronic Panel with Digital Status Display Dishwasher; brand: LG Electronics
2. name: LG Dishwasher; brand: LG Electronics
3. name: LG 4.0 cu. ft. Capacity Front Load Washer w/ Sanitary cycle; brand: LG Electronics

response.text: {"choice": "none", "confidence": 1.0, "reason": "No candidate matches the brand and model number of the price-list item."}
